```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)

# Set project and data directories
dir_project <- "/Users/mdozmorov/Documents/Data/MultipletR"
dir_data <- file.path(dir_project, "10X_gem_classifications")

# Get all gem classification files
gem_files <- list.files(dir_data, pattern = "*_gem_classification.csv", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to process and plot each file
process_gem_file <- function(file_path) {
  # Extract sample title
  title <- gsub("_gem_classification.csv", "", basename(file_path))
  
  # Read data
gem_df <- read.delim(file_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = ",")
  
  # Rename columns
  names(gem_df) <- c("GRCh38_count", "mm10_count", "x10X_Call")
  
  # Compute derived metrics
  gem_df <- gem_df %>%
    mutate(
      percentMouse = mm10_count / (mm10_count + GRCh38_count),
      totalReads = mm10_count + GRCh38_count,
      totalReadsLog = log10(totalReads)
    )
  
  # Get max log reads
  log_max <- max(gem_df$totalReadsLog, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Generate plots
  p1 <- ggplot(gem_df, aes(x = totalReads, y = percentMouse, color = x10X_Call)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("GRCh38" = alpha("royalblue", 0.5), "mm10" = alpha("forestgreen", 0.3), "Multiplet" = alpha("gold", 1))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 500, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.10, 0.90), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.75) +
    labs(title = paste0("10X GEM Multiplet Calls: ", title),
         x = "Total Number of Reads in Cell",
         y = "Percent Mouse") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  p2 <- ggplot(gem_df, aes(x = totalReadsLog, y = percentMouse, color = x10X_Call)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("GRCh38" = alpha("royalblue", 0.5), "mm10" = alpha("forestgreen", 0.3), "Multiplet" = alpha("gold", 1))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log(500), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", linewidth = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.10, 0.90), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.75) +
    labs(title = paste0("10X GEM Multiplet Calls: ", title),
         x = "Log of Total Number of Reads in Cell",
         y = "Percent Mouse") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Combine and display plots
  print(p1 / p2)
}

# Process all files
lapply(gem_files, process_gem_file)

```
